app.name: StoatMD
sync.later: Cloud sync comes after the local vault works
sync.authorizing.desc: Finish in your browser, then come back here.
sync.enableDesc: Your local vault always works. Sync is optional: connect your own cloud drive to align across devices.
sync.agentHint: Recommended · your Personal Agent can read and write the same vault
sync.provider.pickDesc: Sync supports Google Drive and Dropbox: global reach, agent friendly.
sync.folder.title: Choose the remote vault folder
sync.folder.desc: Your local folder stays the same; this just adds an alignment path.
sync.disconnect.title: Disconnect sync?
sync.disconnect.desc: Local files stay untouched and you can reconnect later. Stored alignment anchors will be cleared.
sync.error.network: Network unavailable. Local editing continues; sync retries automatically.
sync.error.auth: Authorization expired. Please reconnect the drive.
sync.error.config: Cloud client credentials are missing. Finish the developer setup first.
sync.paywall.title: Sync is a paid feature
sync.paywall.desc: The local vault is free forever; cloud alignment unlocks after purchase.
sync.noVault: Open a local vault before turning on sync.
sync.conflict.title: Resolve sync conflicts
sync.conflict.desc: Both sides changed. Pick which copy to keep — nothing is overwritten silently.
sync.conflict.keepBothHint: The cloud copy is saved as "name (cloud conflict date).md"
sync.conflict.confirmDesc: The same choice will be applied to every matching conflict.
settings.title: Settings
settings.renderMode.desc: Color distinguishes headings, quotes, links, and code. Monochrome keeps type sizes, weights, and layout. Applies to editing and preview.
settings.theme.desc: Colors only, layout stays put. Presets from Otty themes.
settings.font.desc: The editor and preview share a body font. Adjust interface, editor and reading sizes independently. Changes are saved automatically.
settings.font.preview: A good piece of writing expands a structure, not a pile of sparks.
settings.logo.desc: Choose the icon shown in the Dock and the app switcher.
rename.title: Rename Note
rename.desc: Only the file name changes; the content stays put. The extension is added automatically.
rename.label: File name
rename.error.empty: The file name can't be empty
rename.error.invalid: The file name can't contain / or start with .
rename.error.exists: A file with that name already exists
trash.title: Move to Trash?
trash.desc: “{name}” will move to the Trash and can be recovered from there.
vault.empty.hint: Choose a local folder as your vault. Ordinary .md files inside are read and written.
vault.conflict.title: File changed on disk
vault.conflict.description: The file on disk differs from the editor. Keep local edits to overwrite disk, or reload to discard unsaved changes.
inspector.outline.emptyHint: Write a # heading and it will appear here.
storage.title: Storage
storage.description: Choose one location for your library.
storage.cacheDescription: An offline copy is managed by StoatMD. Changes sync when you reconnect.
storage.expired: Cloud sync paused · Pro required. You can move your library to a local folder.
storage.folderDescription: Choose the destination. Review the migration before switching.
storage.mergeDescription: Notes, attachments and folders are copied and verified. If names conflict, the incoming library is kept in a separate folder to preserve relative links. Hidden files and app metadata stay at the source.
storage.keepOriginal: Keep data in the original location
storage.cleanupDescription: After verification and switching, only migrated files that remain unchanged will be removed from the source. Other files and folders stay there.
storage.failure: Migration stopped. Your original storage remains active.
storage.progressDescription: Editing and sync are paused until the migration finishes.
storage.successDescription: Your library is ready in the new location. The previous location is detached.
storage.cleanupWarning: Your new storage is active. Some original files were kept because cleanup could not finish or files changed.
storage.activationWarning: Storage changed. Reopen the library to refresh the view.
storage.paywallDescription: Pro unlocks Dropbox and Google Drive. Local storage is free. You can always migrate from the cloud back to a local folder.
storage.error.overlap: Choose a separate destination outside the current library.
storage.error.pendingCleanup: Finish the previous cleanup, or choose to keep the remaining files, before starting another migration.
storage.error.sourceChanged: Source files changed during migration. Retry to include the latest files.
storage.error.unsaved: Save the current note or resolve its conflict before migrating.
storage.error.account: Reconnect using the cloud account linked to the original storage location.
storage.error.destinationChanged: Destination files changed during migration. Please retry.
search.failed: Search failed. Edit the query to retry.
mobile.emptyHint: Create a note to start writing.
mobile.conflictHint: Save your edits as a copy to keep both versions, or load the file from disk.
mobile.tool.heading: Heading
mobile.file.invalid: Choose a Markdown or text file with a valid filename.
mobile.file.tooLarge: Choose a file smaller than 5 MB.
mobile.file.encoding: Save the file as UTF-8 and try again.
mobile.file.busy: Wait for the screen to finish opening, then try again.
mobile.connectHint: Choose Google Drive or Dropbox. Your notebook stays available offline after the first sync.
mobile.paidCloud: The paid iOS app includes cloud sync. Connect your account to get started.
